note: Who may approve Clockgrove's goldens, read offline by `clockgrove-assets check` and the asset deploy gate (packages/assets/docs/pipeline.md#golden-approval). A golden approval names an approver: {"kind": "person", "login"} with a login listed under people, or {"kind": "agent", "agent", "delegation"} citing the id of a delegation recorded here. People and delegations are added only in a reviewed change; CI never approves.

delegations.grant: Standing: an agent may approve Clockgrove's fixture-world golden captures at their exact digests, after inspecting each one at its declared viewport and backend.
